item.title: What mattered in AI agents yesterday — 2026-07-15
item.description: What mattered in AI agents yesterday — 2026-07-15 OpenAI launches GPT-5.6 and superapp According to a Latent Space report, OpenAI released GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra/Luna models and folded Codex into a superapp, with usage reportedly spiking. This information is based on third-party reporting and has not been fully confirmed by an official source. If true, it signals a push to consolidate coding assistance into a single platform — directly challenging other agent-native tools.
